name: glue-rimworld
description: RimWorld consumer manifest for the shared Glue Editor actor surface. The editor renders the shared observation/receipt contract while the native mod remains authoritative for RimWorld facts, target legality, reservation, reachability, and job admission.

GLUE_RimworldCandidatePack.description: Declarative RimWorld candidate and native-job mapping pack. Glue ranks semantic intents; the RimWorld adapter owns native legality and admission.

GLUE_RimworldMountPolicy.description: Declarative RimWorld live-colony mount policy. The shared editor owns projection and session vocabulary; the native adapter owns facts, actions, and lifecycle authority.

GLUE_RimworldActorSessionCatalog.description: Provider-neutral actor identity, observation, reconciliation, and typed-rejection contract aligned with GlueZomboid. It declares no client-side gameplay mutation.

GLUE_RimworldPublishValidationProfile.description: Declarative publish proof profile covering the bounded headless harness, native fail-closed admission, retained mount, editor lifecycle, and RimWorld/Zomboid parity.

GLUE_RimworldHeadlessHarness.description: Bounded no-game-launch execution contract for the shared C# actor, receipt, and retained mount surface.

GLUE_RimworldHeadlessWorldFixture.description: Deterministic semantic world/actor input consumed by the headless harness; it contains no native RimWorld object handles or gameplay authority.

GLUE_RimworldWorkshopAffordanceCatalog.description: Declarative Steam Workshop review set. It records source-backed mechanics, native authority boundaries, and candidate Glue projections without importing third-party implementation code.

GLUE_RimworldWorkshopStructuralReview.description: Bounded structural review contract for only the catalog's known Workshop payload roots; emits metadata, capability evidence, and explicit missing/version-gap facts without enabling or copying third-party files.

GLUE_RimworldCrossCorpusAffordanceMap.description: Declarative synthesis mapping Glue, GlueZomboid, Vintage actors, and Burn the Colonies concepts onto RimWorld Workshop mechanics, native admission seams, and publishable acceptance fixtures.

GLUE_RimworldHelpToolingLensPolicy.description: Declares the primary Glue routes, sanctioned capacity-safe fallbacks, forbidden bypasses, and receipt fields that prevent a fallback from being mistaken for editor or native validation.

GLUE_RimworldMountSessions.description: In-memory host-side retention for the current RimWorld colony mount heartbeat. Records are projections, never gameplay authority.
